newsitem.title: USA: DenAmerica plans to acquire Good Eats.
newsitem.headline: DenAmerica plans to acquire Good Eats.

text.p: DenAmerica Corp, a restaurant operator, on Tuesday said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Good Eats Holding Co, a Texas based owner of 13 restaurants and franchiser of four restaurants.
Good Eats generates annual sales of about $17 million.

In a statement, DenAmerica said it expects to issue 1.5 million common shares to acquire the company and upon closing the deal, 56-year-old Gene Street will be named President of Good Eats and Black-eyed Pea USA Inc, a unit of DenAmerica.
Street is currently the controlling shareholder of Good Eats and the founder of the Black-eyed Pea restaurant chain.
